major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown whenever at least 25 seconds of combat remain, then feed Blackout Kick for Stomps and, as Shado-Pan, cycle Keg Smash and Breath of Fire for the whole 25 second window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Efficient Training (Shado-Pan) cuts the cooldown to 95s; 120s is the base value from the ability table.

major_cooldowns.name: Exploding Keg
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Throw it early in a pull for the burst and the free Keg Smash reset, holding it until Keg Smash is under one charge, with Rushing Jade Wind already ticking when you have it talented.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Snipe it the moment the target's current health drops under your own maximum health for triple damage, otherwise take the guaranteed cast under 15% with Improved Touch of Death.

major_cooldowns.name: Black Ox Brew
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it off the global cooldown when Celestial Brew or Celestial Infusion is under one charge and your Energy and Purifying Brew charges are low enough that the refill is not wasted.

rule.description: Shuffle stays up for the whole fight
rule.action: Hold 100% Shuffle uptime. Keg Smash gives 5 seconds, Blackout Kick 3, Spinning Crane Kick up to 4, and it extends to a 15 second cap, so never let the rotation stall.

rule.description: Breath of Fire fills Invoke Niuzao windows
rule.action: As Shado-Pan, spend the whole 25 second Niuzao window cycling Keg Smash and Breath of Fire instead of filling with Tiger Palm: Keg Smash resets Breath of Fire through Sal'salabim's Strength and every Breath of Fire under the celestial triggers another set of Flurry Strikes.

rule.description: Spend Empty Barrel on the next Keg Smash
rule.action: You can only hold 1 Empty Barrel, so cast Keg Smash as soon as one appears; that cast is free and resets Keg Smash again through Bring Me Another.
Follow every Exploding Keg with Keg Smash inside the damage window: the keg resets one Keg Smash charge and that cast feeds Fuel on the Fire and Flurry Strikes.

rule.description: Keg Smash opener into Exploding Keg and Niuzao
rule.action: Open Keg Smash, Blackout Kick, Breath of Fire, Tiger Palm, then Exploding Keg and Invoke Niuzao in either order. Establish Shuffle first; pre-pull Breath of Fire at 3 seconds and Chi Burst at 1 second.

rule.description: Tiger Palm never starves Keg Smash
rule.action: Only fill with Tiger Palm above roughly 50 Energy so the 40 Energy for the next Keg Smash is always there. Keg Smash on cooldown is your damage, your Brew cooldown reduction and your Shuffle.
